decision: D-089 amendment 2 (Dion, 7 Oct 2026), locked before any QA-E02 call
rule: Staged challengers: Stage A = 20 optimization fixed-input pairs only, evaluated offline; stage-a-check decides stop or continue_to_ranking from selection_rule_v2.json; Stage B = 19 ranking pairs only if continue. Stop reasons: quote validity < 1.0; unsupported positives above the locked limit; prompt/schema-induced failure; other regression; path A and path B both unreachable (they are unit-level, so final after Stage A). Ranking never rescues a Stage A failure. E03 is not approved by default; it runs only if E01/E02 leave the decision ambiguous and Dion asks for it. If E02 stops at Stage A and nothing is eligible: keep the baseline and stop Phase A.
